There's plenty of entertaining space inside and outside this home making it perfect for large groups. The rooftop patio is perfect for events with endless gorgeous views!!

The Space:

Welcome to Boujee at the Beach, a brand-new luxury retreat in Inlet Beach designed for guests who like their beach time polished and their downtime elevated. Whether you’re mixing remote work with ocean air or gathering your favorite people for a stylish escape, this home delivers comfort, convenience, and serious rooftop vibes.



The showstopper is the 1,000 sq ft rooftop deck with panoramic Gulf views. Think sunset hot tub soaks, firepit conversations, rooftop dinners, and a ping pong table that keeps the energy going long after golden hour. It’s the kind of space that turns a vacation into a memory.



Inside, the home is modern, spacious, and thoughtfully designed for both social time and privacy. Fast Wi-Fi, Smart TVs throughout, and multiple living areas make it easy to balance work, play, and rest.



Step outside and you’re moments from the best of Inlet Beach and 30A. Walk to Donut Hole, Avenue 30A dining and shopping, or hop on the complimentary golf cart for an easy ride to the beach or Rosemary Beach. When you want more action, Pier Park and Panama City Beach attractions are just a short drive away.



Highlights

• 5 Bedrooms | 4.5 Baths | Sleeps up to 14

• Massive rooftop deck with Gulf views

• Private rooftop hot tub + community pool access

• Rooftop dining, firepit lounge, and ping pong table

• Complimentary golf cart

• Free high-speed Wi-Fi & Smart TVs throughout

• Ideal for friend groups, work-from-anywhere stays, and elevated getaways



Sleeping Layout



First Floor (Sleeps 4)

• King suite with en-suite bath

• Living room with queen pullout sofa



Second Floor

• Open-concept kitchen, dining, and living space



Third Floor (Sleeps 10)

• King suite with en-suite bath

• Two queen bedrooms

• Bunk room with en-suite bath (twin over queen + twin trundle)



Fourth Floor

• Rooftop deck with hot tub, luxury seating, dining area, and ping pong

Guest Access:

We offer convenient door codes for self-check-in. 850 Vacation Rentals by Portoro uses convenient keyless entry for self check-in, details provided 2 weeks (or less) prior to arrival by email and text message.



• Early check-ins or late check-outs: If the property happens to be ready earlier than the standard 4 pm check-in time on the day of your arrival, in most cases an early arrival option may be available when confirmed with the main office. Late check-outs must be confirmed with main office staff prior to the date of departure.



Available for Events (See Other Things to Note for fees/terms.)

- Weddings

- Reunions

- Corporate Functions

- Multiple Family Gatherings



Included Golf Cart Guidelines and Use

- A golf cart is available at the property for guest use by the homeowner. You agree to complete a waiver document regarding the use and liability of the included golf cart which will be issued to you by email/text to be completed by esignature prior to the release of the cart access activation code.



The Neighborhood:

South Walton County's Inlet Beach is located along Florida's Emerald Coast. Earning its name from Phillips Inlet on Lake Powell, Inlet Beach offers the perfect “Old Florida” experience, with gorgeous views of white sandy beaches and coastal dunes. Enjoy public beaches, swimming, beachcombing, sunbathing, fishing, & kayaking! Inlet Beach offers an amazing 30A beach vacation experience!



Things to See:

• Local Experiences: Attycat's Arcade, 30A Beach Bonfires, Beach Paddle Surf,

• Local Restaurants & Shopping

- Restaurants: Shades Bar & Grill, Shaka Sushi & Cocktail Bar, The Donut Hole, Canopy Road Cafe, Amici 30A Mexican Kitchen, Freshii, Cuvee 30A

- Shops: 30A Olive Oil Co, The Blue Giraffe, Not Too Shabby, Myst, Becasa & more!



Annual Festivals & Events:

• Baytowne Beer Festival

• Harvest Wine & Food Festival

• Seeing Red Wine Festival

• Alys Beach Crafted

• Digital Graffiti in Alys Beach

• 30A Wine Festival at Alys Beach

• Noche de los Muertos at Alys Beach

• 30A Songwriters Festival



We provide a full list of Things to Do & See and local Restaurants & Shops to experience for our guests including in a personalized Guest Manual in your check-in details provided prior to your stay!

Getting Around:

You'll find that Inlet Beach provides easy access to dining, shopping, and local entertainment. Guests have access to several beaches in the region! Bikes/Cycling or taking public transportation are alternate options (Major corridors in close proximity to South Walton include: I-65, I-55, I-10, and US Hwy 331). While you may be traveling by your/rental vehicle, if you need additional transportation or nearest airport information, we have you covered!



Traveling to/around Inlet Beach, Florida:

• Taxi Cabs [i.e., Panhandle Transportation Group, Miramar Beach Shuttle, Marcowhale Limo Shuttle and Tax Service]

• Uber, Lyft

• Bike/Cycling [Rentals: Coastal Cruisers, Fun Pug Bike Rentals, Runaway Rentals, Sweet Escape Rentals]



Airports:

• Destin-Fort Walton Beach Airport (VPS) [35 miles north-northwest of downtown Destin]

• Northwest Florida Beaches International Airport (ECP) [35 miles east of Destin]



Popular Landmarks:

• Camp Helen State Park (National Recreation & Parks Association`s Gold Medal Award)

• Lake Powell

• Timpoochee Trail

• Cobia Reef



Interaction with Guests:

Our goal is that your vacation exceed your expectations. 850 Vacations by Portoro communicates via email and phone. After a booking is confirmed, rental agreement will be emailed to the guest for e-signature. Check-in instructions are sent by email and text message 14 days (or less) prior to arrival date. We offer convenient keyless entry for self-check in. We do typically check in with guests by text 1-2 times during their stays to ensure a 5-star experience and remain available for any questions. We are available to guests 24/7 for any inquiries.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
